messages:
jared: FYI nightly e2e-load job failed — p99 jumped ~2.8x and throughput down ~35% since yesterday
maya: saw it on the perf dashboard, looks like start point ~03:12 UTC, tagging @liwei @chris
liwei: can someone bisect the commit range? need to know if it's batching or kernel selection
jared: failing run: https://perf.example.com/runs/8673 — artifacts + traces linked there
jared: quick summary from logs: sudden KV miss spikes and a larger batching.window_ms value
chris: i can start a bisect. which local test to run for a reliable repro?
liwei: run ./tools/e2e_run.sh --profile load --seed 42 — to speed up use ENV PERF_SMALLER_WORK=1
chris: ok kicking off bisect now — i'll post suspect commit id when found
sree: re-ran the job on main@1767834001, same symptoms (so not a flake)
deploy-bot: CI rerun queued for thread 1767834567 (job: e2e-load) by chris
maya: note: PR ab12ef changed batching.window_ms from 5ms -> 15ms earlier this week
jared: log snippet from failing run:
```
[2025-09-12T03:12:11Z] kv_cache miss_rate=0.34
[2025-09-12T03:12:11Z] batching.window_ms=15
[2025-09-12T03:12:12Z] p99=432ms p95=210ms throughput=120req/s
```
chris: bisect update: narrowed down to commits ab12ef..c3f4d2, running finer range now :mag_right:
chris: found culprit — commit c3f4d2 modifies batching heuristics and kernel fallback ordering
liwei: if that's the case, can you try reverting batching.window_ms to 5ms on a canary build? i can profile KV cache behavior afterward
maya: also flagging compilation kernel changes last week — fallback paths may have regressed perf for short sequences
chris: opened PR #489 to revert the batching change, running canary now
ops: approved quick canary deploy :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary deploy started at 1767834800 by ops
jared: will monitor the canary run and post updated p95/p99 + throughput in this thread once it finishes
chris: bisect complete — culprit confirmed commit c3f4d2, PR submitted to revert
liwei: i'll run a profiler on the canary when it's up and attach flamegraphs to the run artifacts
sree: if revert fixes it we should add a regression test that asserts p99 baseline for the load profile
jared: agree — let's also lock batching.window_ms change behind a perf CI check until we have more coverage
maya: thanks all. i'll add notes to the changelog and ping platform owners
liwei: leaving additional reproduction steps in PR #489 comments
jared: last_message: keeping this thread open until canary results are green
